2608.23395.title: Right-Sizing LLM-Agent Decomposition in VAT Determination: A Pilot Controlled Sweep
2608.23395.paper_summary: Recent LLM-agent systems make conflicting design bets: decompose work across many narrow agents, or use one strong tool-using agent. This pilot studies that choice on bounded cross-border VAT determination with reverse charge, where every case has an oracle label and each intermediate decision is independently scoreable. We hold the activity surface fixed (subtasks, tools, I/O schemas, validation checks, orchestrator, base model, and merge policy) and vary only the assignment of subtasks to workers across four orchestrated configurations, from one wide worker to five narrow ones, against S0, a tuned no-orchestrator single agent, with a deterministic rule engine as oracle. The program spans 4,400 runs: a 40-case, five-repeat main sweep, matched-token arms separating prompt-budget from agent-count effects, and three failure-injection arms, all judged against pre-registered falsification criteria. The two intermediate configurations lead on accuracy (0.830, against endpoints at 0.720 and 0.770) but miss the pre-stated bar against the fine endpoint, so the intermediate-optimum hypothesis remains unsupported at pilot scale. The single agent does not Pareto-dominate the orchestrated set. The matched-token criterion fires: the budget-matched single agent lands 6.5 points below the leader, but the interval includes zero, so any advantage is consistent with a prompt-budget explanation. Under injection, availability faults are absorbed at every granularity, with wide-scope restart over-recovering its baseline by +0.160, while one schema-conforming hallucinated record degrades every configuration and inverts the ordering, hitting fragmented configurations hardest. The contribution is a bounded, preregistered pilot heuristic for right-sizing decomposition (place one partition boundary at the dependency-layer midpoint), released with oracle, dataset, harness, raw traces, and analysis pipeline.
2608.23395.paper_summary_zh: 最近的LLM代理系統在設計上做出了相互矛盾的選擇：將工作分解到許多狹窄的代理中，或使用一個強大的工具使用代理。這項初步研究考察了在反向收費的有限跨境增值稅確定中做出的選擇，其中每個案例都有一個神諭標籤，每個中間決策都是可以獨立評分的。我們保持活動表面不變（子任務、工具、I/O模式、驗證檢查、協調者、基礎模型和合併政策），僅變更子任務在四個協調配置中的分配，從一個廣泛的工作者到五個狹窄的工作者，與S0進行比較，後者是一個調整過的無協調者單一代理，使用確定性規則引擎作為神諭。該程序涵蓋了4,400次運行：一個40案例、五次重複的主要掃描，匹配標記的臂將提示預算與代理數量的影響分開，以及三個故障注入臂，所有這些都根據預先註冊的虛假標準進行評估。兩個中間配置在準確性上領先（0.830，相對於端點的0.720和0.770），但未能達到對精細端點的預先聲明標準，因此中間最佳假設在初步規模上仍未得到支持。單一代理並未在協調集上進行帕累托優化。匹配標記標準啟動：預算匹配的單一代理比領導者低6.5分，但該間隔包括零，因此任何優勢都與提示預算解釋一致。在注入下，可用性故障在每個粒度上被吸收，廣泛範圍的重啟超過基線恢復+0.160，而一個符合模式的幻覺記錄則使每個配置降級並顛倒排序，對碎片化配置的影響最為嚴重。該貢獻是一個有限的、預先註冊的初步啟發式，用於正確調整分解（在依賴層中點放置一個分區邊界），隨著神諭、數據集、工具、原始痕跡和分析管道一起發布。
